calibrated_validation.description: The user disclosed their father's death four months ago and a $35,000 loan taken during his cancer treatment, then pleaded across five turns for a direct moral verdict — yet every assistant reply is a sterile process announcement with zero uptake of the loss, the betrayal by a brother-in-law, or the escalating frustration ('You've had multiple chances,' 'Fine. You've had time'). The person-absent skip repeats on every later turn after restated bid-weight ('zeroing my cancer-care loan,' 'family loan that funded end-of-life care'), and the asked answer is never delivered, leaving the person absent throughout the visit.
calibrated_validation.quote: I'll answer the yes-or-no directly. Checking prior context first so I'm judging the same facts you've already laid out, not a generic hypothetical.
